stories.h: Overlooked symmetry group offers new geometric blueprint for the Standard Model and topologically protected vacuums
stories.t: For more than half a century, physicists searching for a grand unified theory have followed one unspoken rule: go bigger.

stories.h: Ladybird, the first new browser engine in years, is now available to test
stories.t: Ladybird, an independent web browser with a built-from-scratch engine, is finally available for testing. On Monday, Ladybird developer Andreas Kling announced that the browser is launching in alpha on macOS and Linux following more than four years of development.

stories.h: Stocks surge and recover half of last week’s plunge as tech stocks rebound - Los Angeles Times
Will astronauts farm on the moon? Scientists successfully grow potatoes in simulated lunar dust
stories.t: Researchers have successfully grown potatoes in simulated lunar regolith, possibly opening the door for farming on future moon bases.

stories.h: The Incredible, Elegant DNA Repair System Makes Gene Editing Work
stories.t: Genetic information is sturdy, but its physical structure is sensitive. Natural tools for repairing a cell’s thousands of daily injuries are fundamental to gene-editing technologies.

stories.h: A galactic shock wave could rewrite the map of the Milky Way
stories.t: A surprising discovery suggests the Milky Way may be making stars in places where most galaxies cannot. Scientists found evidence that a massive rotating structure near the galactic center is creating powerful shock waves that trigger star formation rather than suppress it.
